content.short: Self-hosted crypto payment gateway you run on your own server, with no signup or freezes.
content.description: PayRam is a payment processor a merchant deploys on their own server with one command, in about ten minutes, so no third party can approve, freeze or censor their payments. It accepts stablecoins and crypto on many chains and adds a card-to-crypto on-ramp covering 300+ payment methods in 100+ countries. AI agents can use it too, and it has settled more than $100 million for over 100 merchants.
content.meta: Run PayRam on your own server to accept stablecoin and card payments with no signup, approvals or account freezes.
